mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and dehydration may potentiate pregabalin's CNS depression and increase risk of dizziness, confusion, and falls; both drugs can cause fluid/electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (especially potassium), renal function, and fluid status regularly; counsel patient on fall precautions and signs of hypokalemia; adjust pregabalin dose if renal impairment develops from diuretic use.
